name: The Fall of the Executioner: Kathryn Vane Sleys Captain Severus

cycle_advancement.world_state: Captain Severus Slain — The Void Ascendant Commands Sub-Level 404

locations_modified.ambient_tension: The shattered Terminator plate of Captain Severus lies broken across the floating basalt stones of the Basilica. Eclipser's dark-matter blade delivered an apocalyptic 8,846.6 net damage blow, cutting clean through the Iron Halo and adamantium armor. Kathryn Vane stands victorious, her violet warp-aura burning into the open sky as the Ultramarines Strike Cruiser above panics in disarray.

completed_milestones.title: The Slaying of Captain Severus (Avenger of the Betrayed)
completed_milestones.consequence: Kathryn Vane, The Void Ascendant, surged across the floating debris of Sub-Level 404 and executed Captain Severus with Eclipser, shouting 'You betrayed us, you will pay!' The strike shattered the Ultramarines execution force and avenged the fallen garrison of 404.

active_disasters_and_trials.name: The Assault on the 'Honor of Macragge'
active_disasters_and_trials.threat: With Captain Severus slain, the Strike Cruiser 'Honor of Macragge' in high orbit prepares emergency orbital lances to glass Hive Tartarus, while Kathryn Vane harnesses the anti-gravitational void singularity to ascend into orbit.
active_disasters_and_trials.human_trial: Ascend through the atmosphere of Hive Tartarus on wings of dark matter and board or destroy the Strike Cruiser that brought the purge order.

loc_bastion_gate.threat: Warp Current Channeling to High Orbit

new_decision.decision: Cleaved Captain Severus with Eclipser, screaming the vow of vengeance for Bragg, Kroll, Jax, and Malachi.
new_decision.impact: Slew the transhuman executioner and turned gaze toward the heavens.
